purpose: One-time brand-wide Facebook evidence search after archival reset; no automated schedule or PDF publication
scope: All Atomos products, services, accessories and brand mentions. Includes official, distributor, retailer, creator and community post/comment/reel/story candidates where public source evidence permits.
verification_rules: A Facebook finding requires an original Facebook post, comment, Reel or Story permalink, attributable page/author and source text or a reliable original-source capture.
Published date must be shown by source evidence to include in October.
Engagement, sentiment, images and type must not be invented. Missing data remain null.
Off-platform manufacturer news and LinkedIn posts are not evidence that a Facebook post exists.
An inaccessible page or nonindexed post is an access gap, not evidence of zero posts.
